assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Left: an isosceles trapezoid with top T, bottom T + l and legs l, subdivided into unit equilateral triangles. Right: a strip of alternating unit triangles forming a trapezoid with parallel sides 1007 and 1008 and legs 1 (drawn shorter).

difficulty_rationale: Several connected steps: angles must be multiples of 60 degrees, sides are integers, the parallelogram case is excluded by parity, and the trapezoid area gives a divisor condition.
